first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports shortening onboarding while improving early product adoption. I would verify the onboarding and activation records before testing a focused onboarding simplification, with guardrails for qualified activation and downstream retention. I would avoid promotional pricing because prior evidence showed materially worse 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard activation-messaging experiment this week. The verified record shows activation messaging increased week-one engagement by 11%, activation by 6%, and 30-day retention by 1%, directly addressing the current activation decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Avoid shortening onboarding broadly: although it improves completion, it increased 60-day churn by 9% in complex-workspace accounts. Segment analysis and downstream retention guardrails should remain in place.
